title: knap.toml
description: Workspace configuration for knap, read by `knap lsp`, `knap lint`, and `knap index` alike. See schemas/README.md for versioning rules.

extensions.description: File extensions treated as notes. Files with other extensions are treated as attachments. Default: ["md"].

new_note_dir.description: Folder relative to the workspace root where Quick Fix 'Create note' actions create new files (e.g. "0-Inbox"). Defaults to the same directory as the current note.

exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from indexing, matched against each entry's path relative to its index root.

skip_dirs.description: Glob patterns matched against bare directory names, pruned from the crawl. Replaces the built-in default (".*", "node_modules", "target") outright when set.

ignore_link_targets.description: Glob patterns matched against a link's raw target text, suppressing broken-link diagnostics.

frontmatter_schema.description: Defines allowed keys and values for a doc's frontmatter. Enables key/value completions and diagnostics.

require_frontmatter.description: Warn on docs that have no '---' frontmatter block at all when required keys exist.

warn_unknown_keys.description: Warn on frontmatter keys not listed in 'fields'.

fields.description: Map of frontmatter key names to their constraints.

required.description: Warn when the key is absent from the doc's frontmatter.

values.description: Allowed values for this key (exact-case). Omit to allow any value.
